mobiglas.title: Junior Rank - Small Cargo Haul
mobiglas.details: Hurston requires prioritization of pickups from local mining facilities. Pick up (any order) from freight elevators at HDMS-Lathan on Arial and HDMS-Bezdek on Arial; drop off at a freight elevator at Everus Harbor above Hurston. Total container size is at most 4 SCU. Handheld tractor beam strongly encouraged.
mobiglas.contact: Chase Hewitt, Jr. Logistics Coordinator, Covalex Shipping
